This is a common JavaScript/TypeScript gotcha where backend data models mark fields as optional but frontend code assumes they're always present.

10	Three bugs were fixed in `packages/KNIRVSERVER` to make KNIRVAGENT connect through the DVE SSH Terminal console.
11	
12	**Bug 1 — Wrong lazy-provisioning condition (`dve_handlers.go`)**
13	`GetSupervisorAgentStatus` and `GetSupervisorAgentSession` both used `!IsRunning()` (any agent running) instead of checking whether THIS DVE's agent was running. Fix: replaced with `GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID) != nil` so provisioning fires per-DVE regardless of other agents.
14	
15	**Why:** If DVE-A's agent was alive, accessing DVE-B skipped provisioning and immediately returned 503.
16	
17	**Bug 2 — JSON-quoted command string (`dve_agent_ws_handler.go`)**
18	`forwardInput` received `string(msg.Data)` where `msg.Data` is `json.RawMessage` — the JSON string encoding includes surrounding `"` quotes. Commands arrived at the agent as `"help"` instead of `help`, so the inference provider was never reached.
19	Fix: `json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr)` before passing to `forwardInput`.

file.content:
---
name: dve-knirvagent-bugs
description: Three bugs fixed in the DVE KNIRVAGENT socket connection and agent provisioning flow
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 45a58647-cfa2-4884-a24f-95ad86862818
---

Three bugs were fixed in `packages/KNIRVSERVER` to make KNIRVAGENT connect through the DVE SSH Terminal console.

**Bug 1 — Wrong lazy-provisioning condition (`dve_handlers.go`)**
`GetSupervisorAgentStatus` and `GetSupervisorAgentSession` both used `!IsRunning()` (any agent running) instead of checking whether THIS DVE's agent was running. Fix: replaced with `GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID) != nil` so provisioning fires per-DVE regardless of other agents.

**Why:** If DVE-A's agent was alive, accessing DVE-B skipped provisioning and immediately returned 503.

**Bug 2 — JSON-quoted command string (`dve_agent_ws_handler.go`)**
`forwardInput` received `string(msg.Data)` where `msg.Data` is `json.RawMessage` — the JSON string encoding includes surrounding `"` quotes. Commands arrived at the agent as `"help"` instead of `help`, so the inference provider was never reached.
Fix: `json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr)` before passing to `forwardInput`.

**Bug 3 — Empty socket dir (`pkg/knirvagent/manager.go`)**
When `SocketPath` was not configured, `socketDir` was empty and socket files landed in the process CWD. Fix: default `socketDir` to `getAgentAppDataDir()/sockets` and call `os.MkdirAll(socketDir)` at the start of `StartAgent`.

**How to apply:** When touching the KNIRVAGENT manager or DVE session handlers, always verify lazy-provisioning is per-DVE and that JSON input is properly unmarshaled before forwarding.

type ChainClientInterface interface {
	VerifyPaymentTransaction(txHash string, expectedAmount int64, expectedRecipient string) (*objects.NRNPayment, error)
	GetTransactionPool() ([]*transactionchain.Transaction, error)
	SubmitTransaction(tx *transactionchain.Transaction) (string, error)
	GetAccountBalance(address string) (int64, error)
	GetBlockHeight() (uint64, error)
	GetChainID() (string, error)
	RegisterDVENode(nodeID, ownerAddress string, stakeAmount int64) (string, error)
	CreateChainSession(dveNodeID, ownerAddress string) (*objects.ChainSession, error)
	ValidateSession(sessionID string) (*objects.ChainSession, error)
	GetSecret(sessionID, secretKey string) (string, error)
	Close() error
}

type ContainerOrchestratorInterface interface {
	ProvisionContainer(rentalID string) (*container.Container, error)
	GetSSHPrivateKey(containerID string) (string, error)
	TerminateContainer(containerID string) error
}

// KnirvagentManagerInterface defines the subset of knirvagent.Manager methods
// needed by DVECreationService to auto-provision the DVE Supervisor Agent.
type KnirvagentManagerInterface interface {
	StartAgent(ctx context.Context, dveID string, startTimeout time.Duration) error
	Start(ctx context.Context) error
	Stop(ctx context.Context) error
	IsRunning() bool
	HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error
	RunningCount() int
}

type DVEManagerInterface interface {
	RegisterNode(req *objects.RegisterNodeRequest) (*objects.DVENode, error)
	UpdateNode(nodeID string, updates map[string]interface{}) (*objects.DVENode, error)
}

type DVECreationService struct {

164	func (dcs *DVECreationService) CreateDVENode(req *objects.DVECreationRequest) (*objects.DVECreationResponse, error) {
165		if req.StakeAmount < dcs.minStakeAmount {
166			return &objects.DVECreationResponse{
167				Success: false,
168				Error:   fmt.Sprintf("minimum stake amount is %d NRN", dcs.minStakeAmount),
169			}, nil
170		}
171	
172		if req.OwnerID == "" || req.OwnerAddress == "" {
173			return &objects.DVECreationResponse{
174				Success: false,
175				Error:   "owner ID and address are required",
176			}, nil
177		}
178	
179		dcs.mu.Lock()
180		dveNodeID := fmt.Sprintf("dve-%s", uuid.New().String()[:12])
181	
182		creation := &objects.DVECreation{
183			ID:             uuid.New().String(),
184			Name:           req.Name,
185			OwnerID:        req.OwnerID,
186			OwnerAddress:   req.OwnerAddress,
187			DVENodeID:      dveNodeID,
188			StakeAmount:    req.StakeAmount,
189			Status:         "pending",
190			TEEType:        req.TEEType,
191			TEEAttestation: req.TEEAttestation,
192			SessionKeyID:   generateSessionKeyID(),
193			Capabilities:   req.Capabilities,
194			ResourceLimits: req.ResourceLimits,
195			RegisteredAt:   time.Now(),
196			LastHeartbeat:  time.Now(),
197			UpdatedAt:      time.Now(),
198			Persistent:     req.Persistent,
199			GracePeriod:    dcs.gracePeriod,
200		}
201	
202		dcs.activeCreations[creation.ID] = creation
203		dcs.mu.Unlock()
204	
205		// Synchronously register the node in the DVE manager so it appears in the
206		// nodes list immediately — this is fast (in-memory + DB write, no I/O).
207		if dcs.dveManager != nil {
208			nodeReq := &objects.RegisterNodeRequest{
209				Name:         creation.Name,
210				TEEType:      creation.TEEType,
211				StakeAmount:  creation.StakeAmount,
212				Location:     "local-dve",
213				Capabilities: creation.Capabilities,
214			}
215			if node, err := dcs.dveManager.RegisterNode(nodeReq); err != nil {
216				log.Printf("[DVE Creation] Warning: Failed to register node in manager: %v", err)
217			} else {
218				dcs.mu.Lock()
219				creation.DVENodeID = node.ID
220				dcs.mu.Unlock()
221				log.Printf("[DVE Creation] Registered DVE node %s immediately for creation %s", node.ID, creation.ID)
222			}
223		}
224	
225		// Save initial pending record to database (no lock needed — buntdb is thread-safe)
226		if err := dcs.saveCreationToDatabase(creation); err != nil {
227			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to save DVE creation to database: %v", err)
228		}
229	
230		// Provision DVE asynchronously — container, agent, chain session
231		go dcs.provisionDVEInBackground(creation, req)
232	
233		return &objects.DVECreationResponse{
234			Success:     true,
235			DVECreation: creation,
236			Message:     "DVE node creation initiated — provisioning in background",
237		}, nil
238	}
239	
240	// provisionDVEInBackground runs in a goroutine. It does the slow work of
241	// container provisioning, DVE manager registration, KNIRVAGENT startup,
242	// and chain session establishment. Updates creation status to "active"
243	// on success or logs errors on failure.
244	func (dcs *DVECreationService) provisionDVEInBackground(creation *objects.DVECreation, req *objects.DVECreationRequest) {
245		// 1. Attempt on-chain registration (best-effort)
246		var registrationTxHash string
247		if dcs.chainClient != nil {
248			txHash, err := dcs.chainClient.RegisterDVENode(creation.DVENodeID, req.OwnerAddress, req.StakeAmount)
249			if err != nil {
250				log.Printf("[DVE Creation] Chain registration failed for %s: %v, proceeding with local provisioning", creation.ID, err)
251			} else {
252				registrationTxHash = txHash
253			}
254		}
255		creation.RegistrationTxHash = registrationTxHash
256	
257		// 2. Provision container if orchestrator is available
258		if dcs.containerOrchestrator != nil {
259			log.Printf("[DVE Creation] Provisioning container for creation %s", creation.ID)
260			container, err := dcs.containerOrchestrator.ProvisionContainer(creation.ID)
261			if err != nil {
262				log.Printf("[DVE Creation] Error provisioning container for %s: %v", creation.ID, err)
263				dcs.updateCreationStatus(creation.ID, "failed")
264				return
265			}
266	
267			// Preserve the manager node ID that was registered synchronously in
268			// CreateDVENode — container.ID is only used internally by the orchestrator
269			// and must not overwrite the stable DVENodeID that the nodes list uses.
270			managerNodeID := creation.DVENodeID

826	// newSocketProxy creates a reverse proxy that dials a Unix socket and forwards
827	// requests to the given target base URL.
828	func newSocketProxy(socketPath, targetBase string) *httputil.ReverseProxy {
829		transport := &http.Transport{
830			DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
831				return net.Dial("unix", socketPath)
832			},
833		}
834		target, _ := url.Parse(targetBase)
835		proxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(target)
836		proxy.Transport = transport
837		// Strip CORS headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own CORS
838		// middleware is the single authority.  Without this the backend can inject
839		// Access-Control-Allow-Origin alongside the gateway's wildcard, producing
840		// the "multiple values" error browsers reject.
841		proxy.ModifyResponse = func(resp *http.Response) error {
842			resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
843			resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Headers")
844			resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Methods")
845			resp.Header.Del("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials")
846			// Strip frame/CSP headers from the upstream response so the gateway's own
847			// wrapWithSecurityHeaders (SAMEORIGIN, proper frame-ancestors CSP) is
848			// authoritative.  Without this the backend's SecurityHeadersMiddleware
849			// (X-Frame-Options: DENY, default-src 'self') overrides the gateway's
850			// permissive settings and blocks iframing in components like the DVE
851			// verification panel.
852			resp.Header.Del("X-Frame-Options")
853			resp.Header.Del("Content-Security-Policy")
854			return nil
855		}
856		return proxy
857	}

content.text:
`loadFromDatabase` correctly loads "active" and "pending" creations into `activeCreations` on restart — the heartbeat routine will pick them up immediately.

The fix is complete. Here's a summary of the bug and what was changed:

---

**Root Cause:** `DVEManager.checkNodeHealth` runs every 30 seconds and marks any DVE node as `"offline"` if its `LastHeartbeat` is older than 2 minutes. When a DVE is activated in KNIRVSERVER, a node is registered with `LastHeartbeat = now`, but nothing ever refreshes that heartbeat. Within 2 minutes the node silently goes offline — `dve-list.js` in the KNIRVGATEWAY WebGUI filters for `status === 'online'`, so the DVE disappears (or never appears if the user opens the page after the grace period).

**Fix — `dve_creation_service.go`:**
- Added `nodeHeartbeatRoutine()` launched in `Start()` alongside the existing cleanup/session goroutines
- Runs every 60 seconds; calls `dcs.dveManager.UpdateNode(nodeID, {"status": "online"})` for every creation whose `Status == "active"` — this refreshes `LastHeartbeat` in both the in-memory nodeTracker and the BuntDB, keeping the node permanently online as long as the creation is active
- On server restart, `loadFromDatabase` already reloads active creations, so the heartbeat routine resumes them automatically

All tests pass. Here's a summary of both fixes:

**Fix 1 — Heartbeat deadlock (503 on `/api/dve-nodes`)**

The original `refreshActiveNodeHeartbeats` called `UpdateNode`, which holds `dm.mu.Lock()` (write lock) while doing BuntDB writes. Go's `sync.RWMutex` blocks all new readers once a writer is waiting — so every incoming `/api/dve-nodes` request (`GetNodes` uses `dm.mu.RLock()`) queued behind the write lock and timed out after 1 minute.

Replaced with a new `HeartbeatNode(nodeID)` method on `DVEManager` that only calls `nodeTracker.UpdateHeartbeat(nodeID)` — no `dm.mu`, no BuntDB, just an in-memory map update under the nodeTracker's own lightweight lock. Since `checkNodeHealth` reads from the nodeTracker, this is sufficient to prevent nodes from being marked offline.

**Fix 2 — Supervisor agent 503 (`context deadline exceeded`)**

`GetSupervisorAgentStatus` was calling `HealthCheck(context.Background())` with no timeout. When the KNIRVAGENT socket isn't reachable, this blocked indefinitely. Wrapped with a 5-second `context.WithTimeout`.

53	// NewDVEManager creates a new DVE Manager instance
54	func NewDVEManager(db *database.BuntDBManager, p2pManager *p2p.DVEP2PManager, ebpfMgr ebpf.ManagerInterface, cfg *config.Config) (*DVEManager, error) {
55		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
56	
57		// Initialize instance registry for remote DVE discovery
58		instanceRegistry, err := NewInstanceRegistry(db, &cfg.DVE.Discovery)
59		if err != nil {
60			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to initialize instance registry: %v", err)
61			// Continue without remote discovery - instance registry will be nil
62		}
63	
64		// Initialize chain-native node discovery (replaces seedDemoDVENodesIfEmpty)
65		var chainDiscovery *ChainNativeNodeDiscovery
66		if cfg.DVE.EnableChainDiscovery {
67			reputationEngine := NewDVEDefaultReputationEngine(db)
68			chainDiscovery = NewChainNativeNodeDiscovery(db, nil, reputationEngine)
69			if err := chainDiscovery.loadCacheFromDatabase(); err != nil {
70				log.Printf("Warning: Failed to load chain discovery cache: %v", err)
71			}
72			log.Println("Chain-native node discovery initialized (production mode)")
73		}
74	
75		manager := &DVEManager{
76			db:          db,
77			p2pManager:  p2pManager,
78			ebpfManager: ebpfMgr,
79			config:      cfg,
80			nodeTracker: &NodeTracker{
81				nodes: make(map[string]*objects.DVENode),
82			},
83			loadBalancer: &LoadBalancer{
84				algorithm: "reputation_based",
85			},
86			instanceRegistry:     instanceRegistry,
87			lsmIntegration:       ebpf.NewLSMIntegration("/var/run/knirv"),
88			chainDiscovery:       chainDiscovery,
89			enableChainDiscovery: cfg.DVE.EnableChainDiscovery,
90			ctx:                  ctx,
91			cancel:               cancel,
92		}
93	
94		// Note: API routes are registered with the unified server
95	
96		// Register P2P message handlers
97		if p2pManager != nil {
98			p2pManager.RegisterMessageHandler(p2p.MessageTypeNodeAnnouncement, manager)
99			p2pManager.RegisterMessageHandler(p2p.MessageTypeNodeHeartbeat, manager)
100		}
101	
102		return manager, nil
103	}

189	// registerNodeInternal registers a new DVE node without locking (caller must hold dm.mu)
190	func (dm *DVEManager) registerNodeInternal(req *objects.RegisterNodeRequest) (*objects.DVENode, error) {
191		// Validate TEE type
192		validTEETypes := map[string]bool{
193			"sgx":              true,
194			"sev-snp":          true,
195			"tdx":              true,
196			"software":         true,
197			"browser-extension": true,
198		}
199		if !validTEETypes[req.TEEType] {
200			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid TEE type: %s. Valid types: sgx, sev-snp, tdx, software, browser-extension", req.TEEType)
201		}
202	
203		node := &objects.DVENode{
204			ID:              uuid.New().String(),
205			Name:            req.Name,
206			Status:          "online",
207			TEEType:         req.TEEType,
208			StakeAmount:     req.StakeAmount,
209			ReputationScore: 100, // Initial reputation
210			Location:        req.Location,
211			IPAddress:       req.IPAddress,
212			SSHPort:         req.SSHPort,
213			PublicKey:       req.PublicKey,
214			Capabilities:    req.Capabilities,
215			LastHeartbeat:   time.Now(),
216			CreatedAt:       time.Now(),
217			UpdatedAt:       time.Now(),
218			Latitude:        req.Latitude,
219			Longitude:       req.Longitude,
220		}
221	
222		// Set browser-extension specific defaults
223		if req.TEEType == "browser-extension" {
224			node.IsRemote = true
225			node.Connected = true
226			node.SSHPort = 0 // No SSH for browser extensions
227		}
228	
229		// Store in database
230		if err := dm.storeNode(node); err != nil {
231			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to store node: %w", err)
232		}
233	
234		// Add to tracker
235		dm.nodeTracker.AddNode(node)
236	
237		// Announce to P2P network
238		if dm.p2pManager != nil {
239			if err := dm.p2pManager.AnnounceNode(node); err != nil {
240				log.Printf("Warning: Failed to announce node to P2P network: %v", err)
241			}
242		}
243	
244		// Register with chain-native discovery if available
245		if dm.chainDiscovery != nil {
246			if _, err := dm.chainDiscovery.RegisterNodeFromChain(node, req.StakeAmount); err != nil {
247				log.Printf("Warning: Failed to register node with chain-native discovery: %v", err)
248			}
249		}
250	
251		log.Printf("DVE node %s (%s) registered successfully", node.ID, node.Name)
252		return node, nil
253	}

361	// NodeFilter represents filters for node queries
362	type NodeFilter struct {
363		Status        string   `json:"status,omitempty"`
364		TEEType       string   `json:"tee_type,omitempty"`
365		Location      string   `json:"location,omitempty"`
366		MinStake      int64    `json:"min_stake,omitempty"`

368		Capabilities  []string `json:"capabilities,omitempty"`
369		Limit         int      `json:"limit,omitempty"`

371	
372	// Matches checks if a node matches the filter criteria
373	func (nf *NodeFilter) Matches(node *objects.DVENode) bool {
374		if nf.Status != "" && node.Status != nf.Status {
375			return false
376		}
377		if nf.TEEType != "" && node.TEEType != nf.TEEType {
378			return false
379		}
380		if nf.Location != "" && node.Location != nf.Location {
381			return false
382		}
383		if nf.MinStake > 0 && node.StakeAmount < nf.MinStake {
384			return false
385		}
386		if nf.MinReputation > 0 && node.ReputationScore < nf.MinReputation {
387			return false
388		}
389		// Check capabilities
390		if len(nf.Capabilities) > 0 {
391			nodeCapMap := make(map[string]bool)
392			for _, cap := range node.Capabilities {
393				nodeCapMap[cap] = true
394			}
395			for _, reqCap := range nf.Capabilities {
396				if !nodeCapMap[reqCap] {
397					return false
398				}
399			}
400		}
401		return true
402	}

582	// handleNodeAnnouncement handles node announcement messages
583	func (dm *DVEManager) handleNodeAnnouncement(msg *objects.P2PMessage) error {
584		// Extract node information from message payload
585		nodeData, ok := msg.Payload["node"]
586		if !ok {
587			return fmt.Errorf("missing node data in announcement")
588		}
589	
590		// Convert to DVENode struct
591		nodeJSON, err := json.Marshal(nodeData)
592		if err != nil {
593			return err
594		}
595	
596		var node objects.DVENode
597		if err := json.Unmarshal(nodeJSON, &node); err != nil {
598			return err
599		}
600	
601		// Update node tracker (in-memory)
602		dm.nodeTracker.UpdateNode(&node)
603	
604		// Persist to database so it's visible to API queries
605		if err := dm.storeNode(&node); err != nil {
606			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to persist P2P discovered node %s to database: %v", node.ID, err)
607		}
608	
609		log.Printf("Received node announcement from %s and persisted to database", node.ID)
610		return nil
611	}

625	// monitorNodes monitors node health and status
626	func (dm *DVEManager) monitorNodes() {
627		ticker := time.NewTicker(30 * time.Second)
628		defer ticker.Stop()
629	
630		for {
631			select {
632			case <-dm.ctx.Done():
633				return
634			case <-ticker.C:
635				dm.checkNodeHealth()
636			}
637		}
638	}

640	// checkNodeHealth checks the health of all nodes
641	func (dm *DVEManager) checkNodeHealth() {
642		nodes := dm.nodeTracker.GetAllNodes()
643		for _, node := range nodes {
644			// Check if node hasn't sent heartbeat in too long
645			if time.Since(node.LastHeartbeat) > 2*time.Minute {
646				if node.Status != "offline" {
647					node.Status = "offline"
648					node.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
649					dm.storeNode(node)
650					dm.nodeTracker.UpdateNode(node)
651					log.Printf("Node %s marked as offline due to missing heartbeat", node.ID)
652				}
653			}
654		}
655	}

657	// cleanupExpiredNodes removes expired nodes
658	func (dm *DVEManager) cleanupExpiredNodes() {
659		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute)
660		defer ticker.Stop()
661	
662		for {
663			select {

790	func (dm *DVEManager) calculateAverageResponseTime() float64 {
791		dm.mu.RLock()
792		ebpfMgr := dm.ebpfManager
793		dm.mu.RUnlock()
794	
795		if ebpfMgr != nil {
796			stats, err := ebpfMgr.GetProcessMetrics()
797			if err == nil && len(stats) > 0 {
798				var totalCPUTime uint64
799				var processCount int
800				for _, s := range stats {
801					totalCPUTime += s.CPUTimeNs
802					processCount++
803				}
804				if processCount > 0 {
805					avgCPUTimeNs := float64(totalCPUTime) / float64(processCount)
806					return avgCPUTimeNs / 1_000_000.0
807				}
808			}
809		}
810	
811		nodes := dm.nodeTracker.GetAllNodes()
812		if len(nodes) == 0 {
813			return 0.0
814		}
815	
816		return 10.0
817	}

819	func (dm *DVEManager) calculateNetworkLatency() float64 {
820		dm.mu.RLock()
821		ebpfMgr := dm.ebpfManager
822		dm.mu.RUnlock()
823	
824		if ebpfMgr != nil {
825			stats, err := ebpfMgr.GetProcessMetrics()
826			if err == nil && len(stats) > 0 {
827				var totalContextSwitches uint32
828				var totalPageFaults uint32
829				var processCount int
830				for _, s := range stats {
831					totalContextSwitches += s.ContextSwitches
832					totalPageFaults += s.PageFaults
833					processCount++
834				}
835				if processCount > 0 {
836					avgContextSwitches := float64(totalContextSwitches) / float64(processCount)
837					avgPageFaults := float64(totalPageFaults) / float64(processCount)
838					latencyScore := (avgContextSwitches * 0.3) + (avgPageFaults * 0.7)
839					return latencyScore
840				}
841			}
842		}
843	
844		if dm.p2pManager != nil {
845			peers := dm.p2pManager.GetConnectedPeers()
846			if len(peers) > 0 {
847				return float64(len(peers)) * 2.0
848			}
849		}
850	
851		return 0.0
852	}

854	func (dm *DVEManager) calculateTEEHealthScore() float64 {
855		dm.mu.RLock()
856		lsm := dm.lsmIntegration
857		dm.mu.RUnlock()
858	
859		if lsm != nil && lsm.IsEnabled() {
860			auditLog := lsm.GetAuditLog()
861			if len(auditLog) == 0 {
862				return 1.0
863			}
864	
865			deniedCount := 0
866			for _, entry := range auditLog {
867				if entry.Decision == "DENY" {
868					deniedCount++
869				}
870			}
871	
872			return 1.0 - (float64(deniedCount) / float64(len(auditLog)))
873		}
874		return 0.98 // High confidence default
875	}

896	// GetNode returns a specific node by ID
897	func (dm *DVEManager) GetNode(nodeID string) (*objects.DVENode, error) {
898		dm.mu.RLock()
899		defer dm.mu.RUnlock()
900	
901		// First try to get from in-memory tracker
902		if dm.nodeTracker != nil {
903			if node, exists := dm.nodeTracker.GetNode(nodeID); exists {
904				return node, nil
905			}
906		}
907	
908		// Fall back to database lookup
909		node, err := dm.getNodeFromDB(nodeID)
910		if err != nil {
911			return nil, fmt.Errorf("node not found")
912		}
913	
914		// Add to tracker for future lookups (best effort, don't fail if tracker is nil)
915		if dm.nodeTracker != nil {
916			dm.nodeTracker.AddNode(node)
917		}
918	
919		return node, nil
920	}

922	// HeartbeatNode refreshes the LastHeartbeat for nodeID in both the in-memory
923	// nodeTracker and the database so that:
924	//   - checkNodeHealth (reads nodeTracker) does not mark the node offline
925	//   - GetNodes (reads DB) continues to return status "online"
926	//
927	// Intentionally does NOT hold dm.mu: BuntDB is internally thread-safe, and
928	// avoiding the write lock prevents new readers (GetNodes/RLock) from being
929	// starved while the heartbeat is written.
930	func (dm *DVEManager) HeartbeatNode(nodeID string) error {
931		if nodeID == "" {
932			return fmt.Errorf("nodeID must not be empty")
933		}
934	
935		// Refresh in-memory tracker so checkNodeHealth skips this node.
936		dm.nodeTracker.UpdateHeartbeat(nodeID)
937	
938		// Persist refreshed heartbeat + online status to DB so GetNodes (which
939		// reads the DB, not the tracker) also returns status "online".
940		node, err := dm.getNodeFromDB(nodeID)
941		if err != nil {
942			// Node not in DB yet — nothing to persist; tracker update is enough.
943			return nil
944		}
945		node.LastHeartbeat = time.Now()
946		node.Status = "online"
947		node.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
948		return dm.storeNode(node)
949	}

951	// UpdateNode updates a DVE node with new information
952	func (dm *DVEManager) UpdateNode(nodeID string, updates map[string]interface{}) (*objects.DVENode, error) {
953		dm.mu.Lock()
954		defer dm.mu.Unlock()
955	
956		// Get existing node from database
957		node, err := dm.getNodeFromDB(nodeID)
958		if err != nil {
959			return nil, fmt.Errorf("node not found: %w", err)
960		}
961	
962		// Apply updates
963		if name, ok := updates["name"].(string); ok && name != "" {
964			node.Name = name
965		}
966		if status, ok := updates["status"].(string); ok && status != "" {
967			node.Status = status
968			// When bringing a node back online, refresh its heartbeat so the
969			// health-check goroutine (checkNodeHealth, 2-min stale threshold)
970			// doesn't immediately revert it back to "offline".
971			if status == "online" {
972				node.LastHeartbeat = time.Now()
973			}
974		}
975		if location, ok := updates["location"].(string); ok {
976			node.Location = location
977		}
978		if ipAddress, ok := updates["ip_address"].(string); ok {
979			node.IPAddress = ipAddress
980		}
981		if stakeAmount, ok := updates["stake_amount"].(float64); ok {
982			node.StakeAmount = int64(stakeAmount)
983		}
984		if capabilities, ok := updates["capabilities"].([]interface{}); ok {
985			node.Capabilities = make([]string, len(capabilities))
986			for i, cap := range capabilities {
987				if capStr, ok := cap.(string); ok {
988					node.Capabilities[i] = capStr
989				}
990			}
991		}
992	
993		node.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
994	
995		// Store updated node in database
996		if err := dm.storeNode(node); err != nil {
997			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update node: %w", err)
998		}
999	
1000		// Update in tracker
1001		dm.nodeTracker.UpdateNode(node)
1002	
1003		log.Printf("DVE node %s updated successfully", nodeID)
1004		return node, nil
1005	}

content.text:
Now I have a clear picture. Here's the root cause:

1. On restart, `loadFromDatabase` loads ALL historically "active" DVE creations
2. `refreshActiveNodeHeartbeats` heartbeats ALL of them → old session DVE nodes come back online
3. Old session DVEs appear in the WebGUI; the newly created DVE may also appear but is outnumbered/confused

The fix involves three coordinated changes:
1. `DVECreationService`: Track only **session-created** creations in heartbeat — not ones loaded from DB
2. `DVEManager`: Mark loaded (non-demo) nodes as offline on startup; keep demo nodes alive via their own heartbeat
3. Add `IsDemo` flag to `DVENode` so demo nodes survive restarts without being mistaken for user DVEs

content.text:
Clean. Here's a summary of every change made and what it fixes:

---

**Root cause confirmed:** On server restart, `loadFromDatabase` loaded ALL historical "active" DVE creations, and `refreshActiveNodeHeartbeats` resurrected every one of their nodes back to "online" — so old session DVEs dominated the WebGUI while newly created DVEs had no advantage.

**Changes made:**

**`internal/objects/dve.go`**
- Added `IsDemo bool` to `DVENode` and `RegisterNodeRequest` — permanent marker so demo nodes can be distinguished from user DVEs across restarts.

**`internal/services/dvemanager/dve_manager.go`**
- `registerNodeInternal`: passes `req.IsDemo` through to the node struct
- `loadNodesFromDB`: marks every non-demo node offline in BuntDB immediately on startup, eliminating the 2-minute stale-online window for old user DVEs
- `seedDemoDVENodesIfEmpty`: changed condition from `totalNodes > 0` → `onlineNodes > 0` so demo nodes are seeded even when old offline nodes exist in the tracker; all 6 demo registrations now set `IsDemo: true`
- `demoHeartbeatRoutine` (new): scans BuntDB for `IsDemo` nodes and heartbeats them every 60s, with an immediate heartbeat 2 seconds after startup to protect nodes loaded from a previous session
- `Start()`: launches `go dm.demoHeartbeatRoutine()`

**`internal/services/dvecreation/dve_creation_service.go`**
- Added `sessionCreations map[string]bool` — tracks creation IDs made in THIS runtime session
- `NewDVECreationService`: initializes the map
- `CreateDVENode`: marks the new creation in `sessionCreations` under the same lock write
- `refreshActiveNodeHeartbeats`: now gates on `sessionCreations[creation.ID]` (old DB-loaded creations are skipped) and also accepts `"pending"` status (so a newly created DVE node is kept alive during the brief provisioning window)

**Net behavior after restart:**
- Old user DVEs → offline immediately (marked by `loadNodesFromDB`), never heartbeated → invisible in WebGUI
- Demo nodes → survive restart (`IsDemo` skips the offline mark), kept alive by `demoHeartbeatRoutine`
- Newly created DVE → node registered as "online", tracked in `sessionCreations`, heartbeated from the first 60s tick → visible in WebGUI
